about_item: FLEA, TICK & MOSQUITO PROTECTION FOR DOGS: Vectra 3D provides powerful flea and tick prevention for dogs while also repelling mosquitoes. Each topical application delivers up to one month of protection.

FAST-ACTING TOPICAL FLEA & TICK TREATMENT: This fast‑acting dog flea and tick treatment begins reducing flea feeding in as little as 5 minutes and kills fleas within 4 hours on dogs—no biting required
PROTECTION FOR DOGS WHO DO MORE: Built for dogs with more everyday exposure - from yards and parks to trails, travel and outdoor family adventures.

MONTHLY TOPICAL ROUTINE: This monthly topical flea and tick treatment uses a single‑dose, direct‑to‑skin applicator with a quick‑drying, non‑greasy formula. Waterproof after 24 hours, making it a dependable dog flea treatment for real‑life conditions.
VET RECOMMENDED, NO PRESCRIPTION NEEDED: Used by veterinarians for nearly 20 years and available without a prescription.

authors_reviews.title: Fast-Acting Flea and Tick Protection for My 4-Year-Old Terrier!
authors_reviews.text: I recently purchased the Vectra 3D for Dogs and Puppies (Gold, for Extra Small Dogs 5-10 lbs, 3-month supply) for my 4-year-old, 10-lb terrier, and it’s been a game-changer for keeping fleas and ticks at bay! This topical treatment, containing Dinotefuran (4.95%), Pyriproxyfen (0.44%), and Permethrin (36.08%), starts reducing flea feeding in just 5 minutes and kills fleas within 4 hours, which is perfect for my active terrier who loves romping through grassy parks. Living in an area where ticks and mosquitoes are common, I’m thrilled that it repels and kills pests like Deer Ticks, Brown Dog Ticks, and mosquitoes without requiring a bite, reducing the risk of Lyme disease and other vector-borne illnesses. It also protects against lice, mites (excluding mange mites), and biting flies, offering broad-spectrum coverage for up to 30 days per dose.Applying Vectra 3D is a breeze with its patented applicator. I part my terrier’s wiry coat at the base of his tail and apply a continuous line to his shoulder blades, as instructed, and the quick-drying, non-greasy formula sets in without leaving a mess or strong odor. My dog showed no irritation or discomfort, which is crucial since terriers can have sensitive skin. The treatment is waterproof after 24 hours, so his occasional puddle-jumping doesn’t reduce its effectiveness. As an eco-conscious pet parent, I appreciate that it’s an over-the-counter product with no prescription needed, and the packaging is minimal, reducing waste.Overall, Vectra 3D has kept my terrier flea- and tick-free, even during our long walks in tick-prone areas. I highly recommend it to owners of small dogs who need reliable, fast-acting protection that’s easy to apply and long-lasting. My terrier and I are both happier for it!
authors_reviews.author: Marina Campbell

authors_reviews.title: Didn’t work against fleas
authors_reviews.text: Vectra 3D did not work at all against fleas. I bought it because our dog started to pick up a couple fleas in our backyard every couple days and wanted to try a topical solution. This was recommended by our vet, but this product did not deter or kill the fleas at all like it promises. Still kept getting fleas every day or two. It also made her coat terribly greasy and made her very itchy where it was applied, but at least she didn’t develop a rash. It is also very strong smelling, and the sprays I have did not work to cover the smell. Just ended up washing it off after a couple weeks and switched to a Seresto collar, which worked well in the past and is working great again with no more fleas. Definitely recommend Seresto collar instead! (It is also cheaper per month and lasts 8 months.)
authors_reviews.author: JoshandShakila
